welcome.title: Getting started
welcome.body: Your schedule, blackout times, lesson notes and invoices in one place. Everything stays on this device: nothing is sent to Tutorcat or anyone else.
welcome.step1: Add your name and payment details in Settings (they go on your invoices).
welcome.step2: Add your students, with their time zone and rate.
welcome.step3: Book lessons (one-off or weekly) and block the times you're not available.
welcome.step4: After each lesson, note what you covered. Invoices build themselves from your lessons.
firstRun.title: Welcome to Tutorcat Desk

firstRun.free: Tutorcat Desk is free for tutors listed on Tutorcat.
firstRun.apply: Apply on Tutorcat's For tutors page

firstRun.data: There's no account, and nothing you type is sent to Tutorcat or anyone else. Back up from Settings now and then: the backup file brings everything back if this browser is cleared, or on a new laptop.

install.title: Install the app
install.done: Installed. Open Tutorcat Desk from your Start menu, Dock or home screen; it works offline.

site.title: Tutorcat Desk: tools for tutors on Tutorcat
site.home: Tutorcat Desk, top of the page
site.hero.title: Your teaching week, sorted.
site.hero.lead: Tutorcat Desk keeps your lessons in one place: a schedule you can drag, the times you're not available, notes on what to teach, and invoices that build themselves. Made for tutors teaching Gulf families, in English and Arabic.
site.proof.device: Your data stays on your device
site.preview.weekLabel: Example of the Tutorcat Desk week view: lessons for three students, Friday prayer blocked, and a paid invoice.
site.features.title: Everything between your lessons
site.features.intro: Four jobs that eat into a tutor's evenings, done in one place.
site.f.schedule.title: A schedule you can drag
site.f.schedule.body: See your week at a glance and move a lesson by dragging it. Weekly lessons stay at the same time for the family, even when your own clocks change.
site.f.schedule.p1: Each lesson shows the family's time next to yours
site.f.schedule.p2: Repeat weekly or every two weeks, then move one lesson or the whole series
site.f.schedule.p3: A warning before two lessons overlap
site.f.blackouts.title: Blackout times
site.f.blackouts.body: Block the times you can't teach: every week, like Friday prayer or school hours, or on dates, like travel and exam season.
site.f.blackouts.p1: Shaded on your calendar, with a warning before you book into them
site.f.blackouts.p2: Ramadan and Eid dates ready to add, marked as estimates
site.f.blackouts.p3: Limit a weekly block to certain dates or hours
site.f.notes.title: Lesson plans and notes
site.f.notes.body: Write what to teach before each lesson, tick it off as you go, and move anything left over to the next lesson in one click.
site.f.notes.p1: Note what you covered and the homework
site.f.notes.p2: Send the family a summary or a reminder on WhatsApp, in their language
site.f.notes.p3: Private notes stay private: they never go into messages or invoices
site.f.invoices.title: Invoices that build themselves
site.f.invoices.body: Pick a family and a month, and the lessons you taught are added for you. Print it or save it as a PDF, in English or Arabic.
site.f.invoices.p1: Prepaid packages, discounts and an optional VAT line
site.f.invoices.p2: Gulf currencies, including the dinar's three decimals
site.f.invoices.p3: Mark invoices paid and see what's still owed

site.extra.today.title: A Today page
site.extra.today.body: Today's lessons, the week ahead, what's unpaid and what's ready to invoice.
site.extra.devices.title: Laptop and phone
site.extra.devices.body: Install it from Chrome, Edge or Safari on Windows or Mac, or add it to your phone's home screen.
site.extra.backup.title: Backups you keep
site.extra.backup.body: Save everything to one file and restore it on a new laptop.
site.privacy.title: Your data stays on your device
site.privacy.body: There's no account. Your students, lessons, notes and invoices are kept in your browser on your own device, and nothing you type is sent to Tutorcat or anyone else. WhatsApp only opens when you press a WhatsApp button, with a message you check first.
site.how.title: Three steps to your copy
site.how.s1.title: Send your details
site.how.s1.body: Fill in the form below: the same details Tutorcat asks for a listing. It opens your email or WhatsApp with everything filled in.
site.how.s2.title: Download Tutorcat Desk
site.how.s2.body: Once you've sent your details on WhatsApp, the download button appears. Install it and add your first student.
site.how.s3.title: The Tutorcat team checks them
site.how.s3.body: We look over your details and, if you'd like, set up or update your Tutorcat profile.
site.signup.title: Get Tutorcat Desk
site.signup.body: These are the same questions as a Tutorcat listing. When you're done, choose how to send them: by email or on WhatsApp. Nothing is sent until you press send there. Send them on WhatsApp and you can download Tutorcat Desk straight away.
site.contact.title: Or contact the Tutorcat team directly
site.faq.title: Questions
site.faq.free.a: Tutorcat Desk is free for tutors listed on Tutorcat.
site.faq.listed.q: Do I need to be listed on Tutorcat?
site.faq.listed.a: Tutorcat Desk is for tutors on Tutorcat. If you're not listed yet, the details you send here are the same ones Tutorcat uses for a listing, so the team can look at both together.
site.faq.devices.q: Does it work on Windows, Mac and phones?
site.faq.devices.a: Yes. It runs in Chrome, Edge or Safari and installs like an app on Windows and Mac. On a phone, add it to your home screen. Once it's installed, it works offline.
site.faq.data.q: Where are my students' details kept?
site.faq.data.a: Only on your device, in your browser. Tutorcat never sees them. Use Back up now in Settings to save a copy, and restore it on another laptop.
site.faq.parents.a: No. Families only see what you choose to send them on WhatsApp: a reminder, a lesson summary or an invoice. Private notes are never included.
site.faq.arabic.a: Yes. The whole app works in Arabic, right to left, and invoices and messages can be in each family's language.
site.footer.about: Tutorcat Desk is made by Tutorcat for the tutors listed on it.
